title: A Nonsequencing Approach for the Rapid Detection of RNA Editing
protocol: Generate predicted melting curves for edited and nonedited gene fragments using uMelt HETS web-based tool.

Design three pairs of gene fragments (300-324 bp in length) for each target gene, including one edited site and one corresponding wild-type site at 5'-terminal end, middle position, or 3'-terminal end.
Select the nonedited/edited pair showing maximum difference between melting regions on helicity axis for further analysis.
Synthesize selected gene fragment by PCR amplification as described in section 2 below.
Dilute primers in TE buffer and store them at a concentration of 100 pmol/µL.
Prior to use, dilute each primer set to 10 pmol/µL using distilled water.
Extract total RNA from the source of edited and nonedited genes using standard methods such as TRIzol extraction or commercially available kits.
Add 1 µl of oligo(dT) primer to a nuclease-free microcentrifuge tube.
Add 1 µl of 10 mM dNTP mix to the tube.
Add 10 µl of total RNA to the tube.
Add 10 µl of sterile distilled water to the tube.
Heat the mixture at 65 °C for 5 min.
Incubate on ice for at least 1 min.
Centrifuge the contents of the tube at maximum speed (12,000 x g) for 2-3 s.
Add 4 µl of 5x ReverTra Ace buffer to the centrifuged mixture.
Add 1 µl of 0.1 M DTT to the mixture.
Add 1 µl of M-MLV reverse transcriptase (200 U/µL) to the mixture.
Mix by pipetting up and down gently.
Incubate the tube at 55 °C for 60 min.
Heat inactivate the reaction by incubating at 70 °C for 15 min.
Measure the concentration of cDNA using a spectrophotometer.
Store the cDNA at -25 °C.
Add 4 µL of 5x Taq Polymerase Buffer to a nuclease-free microcentrifuge tube.
Add 2 µL of 2 mM dNTP mix to the tube.
Add 2 µL of 25 mM MgCl2 to the tube.
Add 1.6 µL of primer set (forward and reverse; each 10 mM) to the tube.
Add 2 µL of cDNA template to the tube.
Add 0.1 µL of Taq polymerase (2.5 U/µL) to the tube.
Add 8.3 µL of sterile distilled water to the tube.
Perform initial denaturation at 95 °C for 2 min.
Perform 35 cycles of denaturation at 95 °C for 2 min.
Anneal at a suitable temperature (depending on specific primer set) for 30 s.
Extend at 72 °C for 2 min after each annealing step.
Perform final extension at 72 °C for 7 min.
Add 2 U of Exonuclease I to the PCR product.
Add 0.5 U of shrimp alkaline phosphatase (ExoSAP) to the mixture.
Incubate the tube in a thermal cycler at 37 °C for 1 h.
Heat incubated sample to 80 °C for 15 min.
Maintain the sample at 4 °C until the next step.
Add 11.5 µL of sterile distilled water to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Add 2.5 µL of forward or reverse primer to the tube.
Add 1 µL of PCR products (with ExoSAP) to the tube for sequencing analysis.
Perform sequencing with both forward and reverse primers.
Dilute purified PCR products to a concentration of 200 ng/µL with deionized water.
Mix 6 μL of the diluted product with 3 μL of 6x gel loading dye in a 250 μL tube.
Raise the total volume to 12 μL with sterile water.
Store the PCR product at -25 °C until ready for µTGGE analysis.
Sandwich the top gel plate between the bottom and lane-former plates for assembly.
Add 7.2 g of urea to a 50 mL tube and dissolve in 10 mL of sterile water.
Heat the solution in a microwave for 20-30 seconds and let it cool to room temperature.
Add 3 mL of 5x TBE buffer, 2.25 mL of 40% acrylamide/bis (19:1), 75 μL of 10x ammonium persulfate, and 15 μL of tetramethylethylenediamine to the solution.
Pour the gel solution into the assembled gel cassette holder slowly to avoid air bubbles.
Soak upper and lower electrophoresis buffer pads in 2 mL of 1x TBE buffer.
Place the gel cassette in the horizontal electrophoresis chamber unit.
Position the upper and lower buffer pads accordingly.
Load 10 µL of PCR product into the middle well.
Load 1 µL of PCR product into each side well.
Connect the power unit and supply 100 V for 12 min at a linear temperature gradient from 25-65 °C.
Pour 300 µL of 10x SYBR Gold stain onto the gel after run completion.
Remove the upper glass cover.
Visualize melting profiles using the blue LED flashlight installed in the device.
